dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Oh, you're here. I can see you've been on quite a few adventures recently.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: As it happens, I do have some matters that require an experienced adventuring hand to resolve.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: If you're interested, go look for Tiantian. I've delegated the task of distributing commissions to her.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Me? Nothing's come up that interests me so far, and at a time like this... the Adventurers' Guild needs someone to hold the fort.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Alright, then. If you'd like to take this task on, go look for Tiantian. She needs to grow up sometime, anyway...
